answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 148453 Country: India Title: Does smoking invalidate wudhu? Question: Does smoking invalidate wudhu? Answer ID: 148453 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 406/321/D=5/1438) It does not invalidate the wudhu but you need to clean your mouth before starting the prayer or reciting the holy Quran so that the bad smell is removed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
